question: How was the training data translated?

extractive_spans: using the machine translation platform Apertium
evidence: Most lexical resources for sentiment analysis are in English. To still be able to benefit from these sources, the lexicons in the AffectiveTweets package were translated to Spanish, using the machine translation platform Apertium BIBREF5 .

Most lexical resources for sentiment analysis are in English. To still be able to benefit from these sources, the lexicons in the AffectiveTweets package were translated to Spanish, using the machine translation platform Apertium BIBREF5 .

title: UG18 at SemEval-2018 Task 1: Generating Additional Training Data for Predicting Emotion Intensity in Spanish
answer_short: The training data was translated into Spanish using the machine translation platform Apertium.
answer_rationale: Text 2 (page=6, section=Translating Data) states that the English datasets were translated into Spanish using Apertium. Text 9 (page=5, section=Translating Lexicons) also confirms the use of Apertium for translating lexicons, reinforcing the use of this platform for translation tasks.
